primitive.relation: one contract, degree balance of a finite digraph (every vertex has equal in- and out-degree; no connectivity, looplessness, inhabitance or tour premise). Migrated: two_extremal.Eulerian (forall v, indeg v = outdeg v over classic_core.indeg) is balanced D by conversion; colouring_variants.eulerian ([forall v, indeg v == outdeg v], Boolean, file-local in-degree) is balancedb D by conversion, reflected by balancedP; X221.x221_eulerian (forall v, outdeg v = indeg v, over classic_core.indeg) is the reversed-equation view balanced_revE, a proved iff. All in-degrees are the comprehension #|[set u | u --> v]|, the public indeg. Deferred: reals_growth.eulerian (same body, but its two non-corpus EC-log rows inherit classical-reals axioms through their statements: a legacy-axiom defect, left byte-identical) and Cycle U6's multigraph eulerian (connected, even arc-end degrees), a different contract. Chromatic.foundations.alon_tarsi.at_eulerian (balance of a supplied finite set of ordered pairs) is a distinct representation, not a source of this family.

legacy-axiom-defect.note: reals_growth.eulerian (forall v : D, indeg v = outdeg v over its file-local in-degree) has the body of balanced D, but it is NOT migrated: its two non-corpus EC-log rows (ec_log_statement, ec_log_c6_statement) inherit four classical-reals axioms (ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_not_dec, sig_forall_dec, FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep, Classical_Prop.classic) through their statements, so any certificate of them fails the kernel assumptions audit required by the plan (section 3, invariant 4). reals_growth.v and grounding_reals2.v stay byte-identical to the baseline; the rejected pin 6dba7ed and its evidence record the attempt. Classified as a deferred legacy-axiom defect, not migrated and not accepted; the kernel evidence re-probes that neither EC-log statement reaches a migrated source or the public module.

prop-degree-balance.note: forall v : D, indeg v = outdeg v with classic_core.indeg = #|Nin v| = #|[set u | u --> v]|: the body of balanced D, convertible. Its corpus row H6_no_full_cover (derived:drv_twoext_h6, phase X1) is frozen complete with every guard in order; its chains realises_Eulerian (Section-parametric in the realisation relation, discharged type explicit), realises_W, realises_E and realises_gw and the two whole non-selected Conjecture 9.2 encodings conj_9_2_glued / conj_9_2_glued_e are frozen over the frozen helper and certified by complete iffs.

prop-degree-balance-reversed.note: forall v : D, outdeg v = indeg v with classic_core.indeg = #|Nin v| = #|[set u | u --> v]|: the reversed equation; equivalent to balanced D by balanced_revE (eq_sym pointwise), a proved iff, not a conversion.

bool-degree-balance.note: [forall v : D, indeg v == outdeg v] with colouring_variants' local indeg: the body of balancedb D, convertible; balancedP reflects it into balanced D.

multigraph-eulerian.note: Cycle U6's eulerian G := mconnected G /\ forall v, ~~ odd (mdeg v) on a multigraph: an UNDIRECTED, connected, even-arc-end-degree contract (a loop counts two); not degree balance of a digraph. Deferred to family B17 for the connected/even predicate and its complete reached rows only; U6's supplied is_eulerian_tour (a closed tour using every edge once) remains separate and unchanged.

upstream_audit.note: coq-graph-theory has no in/out-degree of a finite digraph. The Digraph core has outdeg (core/oriented.v) but no in-degree outside conjecture files (classic_core.indeg over Nin, and two file-local copies in colouring_variants and reals_growth) and no balance predicate. The new public Digraph.foundations.degree_balance owns indeg, balanced and balancedb with the reflection, the reversed view, the converse swap, the handshake sum and arcless balance; outdeg and the three local in-degrees are unchanged. Chromatic.foundations.alon_tarsi.at_eulerian counts the incoming and outgoing arcs of a supplied finite set of ordered pairs (no digraph, no connectivity): a distinct representation, deferred. Closed Eulerian tours, strong connectivity and the undirected multigraph notion stay separate. Legacy bodies and per-row certificates: meta/migration_reports/degree_balance.md.
